steps.title: What is Ticket to Ride?
steps.content:
You're a railroad baron in early 1900s America! You're racing to claim train routes across the country, connecting cities to complete secret destination tickets. The player who builds the best rail network — connecting the most valuable routes — wins!

**Goal:** Score the most points by claiming routes on the map and completing destination tickets.

steps.title: What's on the Table
steps.content:
- **The board** - A map of North America with cities connected by colored routes
- **45 train cars** per player (in your color)
- **Train cards** (8 colors + rainbow Locomotives that are wild)
- **Destination Ticket cards** - Secret goals connecting two cities
- **Scoring markers** - Track your points around the board edge

Each route on the map has a **color** and a **length** (1-6 spaces). You'll claim routes by playing matching colored train cards.

steps.title: Setting Up
steps.content:
1. Each player takes **45 train cars** and a **scoring marker** (place at 0)
2. Shuffle the **Train Card deck**, deal **4 cards** to each player
3. Flip **5 Train Cards** face-up next to the deck
4. Shuffle the **Destination Ticket deck**, deal **3 tickets** to each player
5. Each player must **keep at least 2** destination tickets (you may keep all 3). Return any unwanted tickets to the bottom of the deck.

**Important:** Keep your destination tickets secret! Don't reveal which cities you're trying to connect.

steps.title: What Happens on Your Turn
steps.content:
On your turn, do **exactly one** of these three actions:

**1. Draw Train Cards** - Take 2 cards (from the face-up row or the top of the deck)
- If you take a face-up Locomotive (wild), that's your entire turn — you only get 1 card

**2. Claim a Route** - Play matching colored cards to claim a route on the map
- Place your train cars on the route
- Score points immediately based on route length

**3. Draw Destination Tickets** - Draw 3 new tickets, keep at least 1

That's it — pick one action per turn!

steps.title: Claiming Routes & Scoring
steps.content:
To claim a route, play cards matching the route's **color** and **length**:
- A 3-space blue route needs 3 blue cards
- **Locomotives (rainbow)** are wild — use them as any color
- **Gray routes** can be claimed with any single color

**Points scored by route length:**
| Length | Points |
|--------|--------|
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 4 |
| 4 | 7 |
| 5 | 10 |
| 6 | 15 |

Longer routes are worth much more! A 6-space route is worth 15 points.

steps.title: Destination Tickets
steps.content:
Each destination ticket shows **two cities** and a **point value**.

- **Completed tickets** (both cities connected by your routes) = **add** those points to your score at game end
- **Incomplete tickets** = **subtract** those points from your score!

You don't have to use a direct route — as long as your trains connect the two cities through any path, the ticket is complete.

**Strategy tip:** Look at your tickets early and plan a path that completes multiple tickets efficiently!

steps.title: Game End & First Round
steps.content:
**Game End:** When any player has **2 or fewer train cars** remaining, every player (including that player) gets **one final turn**. Then:
1. Add points for completed destination tickets
2. Subtract points for incomplete tickets
3. **Longest Continuous Path** bonus: 10 points to the player with the longest connected route

**Let's start!** Look at your destination tickets and your 4 train cards:
- Which cities do you need to connect?
- Do your current cards match any routes along the way?
- Your first few turns: probably **draw cards** to build up your hand, then start **claiming routes** toward your destinations.

Have fun building your railroad empire!
